description: Nil FamilySearch Family Tree search — no candidates. Covers the no-ID path so the skill's "call person_search before falling back to stubs" rule can actually run: without a fixture the tool is absent from the mock server and the run reports it unavailable, which is indistinguishable from skipping the search. Matches any surname containing Hennessy, so a search on the mother or a relative resolves too. Per person-search-tool-spec.md a 204 from upstream returns totalMatches 0 with an empty results array.
